hypotheses: Signed fixed-lattice basis has rank n/|H|, entries 0,+1,-1 and disjoint supports.
Odd H-invariant split ideals satisfy d_H^|H|=D; subfield quotient sizes equal exact residue-image sizes.
The order tower inequality f_g*n <= max(2*n,g*f_n) holds for all tested odd residues.
The 2-primary exponent is 2^ceil(s/n), including the first ineligible boundary.
Prime-power and mixed 2-primary/odd ordinary bases support exact collision acquisition and exact rounding/division.
Trivial-stabilizer eligible examples can have only g=n pass; this does not refute the bounded-support asymptotic claim.

precision: Exact integers and fractions; no floats in assertions, no probability tails. Only elapsed time uses float.
